entries.title: Modular Arithmetic: Language Models Solve Math Digit by Digit
entries.method: Fisher-score neuron selection on no-carry arithmetic; natural activation interchange across several MLP layers and seven thresholds; scores hybrid result digits. Supplementary carry-inducing donors test whether a digit patch also moves the next digit. Includes single- and multi-digit tokenizers.
entries.result: Digit-specific hybrid outputs are already causally tested. Carry effects are explicitly investigated and interpreted as largely separate. A simple digit-circuit, carry-locus or tokenizer-generalization finding would overlap.
entries.limit: Reading supports an overlap warning, not a claim that every possible arithmetic computation question has been solved. No candidate selected from this source yet.

entries.title: Specialized Attention Heads in Early Word Reconstruction
entries.method_from_abstract: Within-word attention/weighted-norm selection followed by targeted ablation and activation patching across languages, tokenizers and model families.
entries.limit: General detokenization-head discovery is already claimed. Exact methods and possible distinct contrasts require the paper body; abstract is insufficient for a novelty verdict.
